description: Daily audit coverage by symbol and stage
sql:
SELECT day_start_ms, stage, symbol, record_count
      FROM auto_trader_audit_daily_summary
      WHERE day_start_ms >= :since_ms
      ORDER BY day_start_ms DESC, stage, symbol
      LIMIT :n
limitations: Do not combine local and runtime results
Do not assume paper/live mode from table names
execution_plan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR LAST 2 TERMS OF ORDER BY
